Docky - The dock, rebuit for focus. - Make your dock feel new again | Product Hunt. Download Docky  View on GitHub. It is a row of icons, fixed to one edge, with a single visual style and very few hooks for the way modern Macs are actually used. ## Docky moves with your workflow. Pin what you reach for and actively use. Swap in widgets and create groups. Compose it with apps, widgets, Smart Stacks, and folders. Reach Launchpad, the window switcher, and scripted actions from the same place. Add and arrange items: apps, widgets, Smart Stacks, folders, spacers, dividers. make the dock is your canvas. Open it with any global shortcut you choose. A global Cmd-Tab-style switcher that previews the highlighted window in its actual on-screen position before you commit. ### Widgets in the dock. Calendar, Reminders, Batteries, System, Weather, Now Playing and more live right in your dock. Supported app icons can swap into a live widget face in place. ## What can docky do for you? The window switcher shows live previews of every space and window so you land on the right one the first time. A look at the dock confirms the next meeting, the battery, and what’s playing. Group apps you rarely surface, pin the ones you live in, and let everything else autohide until you reach for it. Yes. Docky is open source and the full source lives on GitHub at github.com/josejuanqm/docky. Open an issue or a pull request on the GitHub repository at github.com/josejuanqm/docky. Does Docky replace the system Dock? Some of Docky’s most useful features like hiding the system Dock, in-place window previews, and Finder automation sit outside what App Store sandboxing currently allows without making the experience worse.
